Sandbox_RefugeZCapes_EnableLoot: Spawn capes, shawls and wings in loot
Sandbox_RefugeZCapes_EnableLoot_tooltip: Enabled by default. When off, this mod adds none of its items to world loot. Existing loot and crafting are unaffected.
Sandbox_RefugeZCapes_LootWeight_tooltip: Default 0.005 is extremely rare. Higher values increase the chance in wardrobes and clothing stores; 0 disables loot.
